title: A cold Lennard-Jones chain
shows: 100 atoms on a ring at 1.12 σ apart, cooled to T = 0.01 ε/k: each has the lattice energy 4·Σ((na)⁻¹² − (na)⁻⁶) = -1.03124 ε over its neighbours within the 2.5 σ cutoff, plus T/2 of potential energy by equipartition in a harmonic crystal.
source: Lennard-Jones lattice sums and equipartition: N. W. Ashcroft and N. D. Mermin, Solid State Physics (1976), ch. 20 and 22; M. P. Allen and D. J. Tildesley, Computer Simulation of Liquids, 2nd ed. (2017), §1.4.

checks.what: potential energy per atom less T/2 (ε)
